subject: Are we still prioritizing? — deck receipt + quick walkthrough request
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Shah <maya@omnitek.ai>
Cc: nikhil_sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + estimate attached (Redwood x Omnitek)

Hi Maya — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and the estimate attached: Redwood-Eval-Estimate-Omnitek.pdf (attached).

Key takeaways:
- Goal: prototype semantic search over customer support docs (500k docs) and embed into product search by Q3.
- Traffic profile: mostly short queries, P95 latency target ~200ms; initial volume ~2k reqs/day, expect growth.
- Data & security: customer data stays in VPC; SOC2 evidence requested for procurement.

Recommendation summary (in the deck):
- Start with hosted Redwood API + prefix caching for the pilot -> lowers ops overhead.
- If throughput grows quickly, move to dedicated pools (we included a committed-capacity option in the estimate).

Next steps I suggested:
1) I can walk the team through the estimate and configuration — 15 minutes to answer pricing/ops questions.
2) Procurement review (SOC2 + SLAs) — we can provide artifacts and an SSO/KMS checklist.
3) Target decision window: 3–4 weeks.

Attachments: Redwood-Eval-Estimate-Omnitek.pdf

If it helps, I can send a one-page pricing summary as well. Are you available for a short walkthrough next week? Here are a couple slots I have: Mon 3/15 10:00–10:15 PT, Tue 3/16 14:00–14:15 PT. Or book me here: https://calendly.com/lauren-bishop/15min

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Shah <maya@omnitek.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:18:36 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + estimate attached (Redwood x Omnitek)

Thanks Lauren — got the deck and estimate, copying our procurement lead Arjun. I'll share with the team and circle back with any questions. Two quick items for the walkthrough if we do it:
- Can you confirm peak token pricing and expected per-request cost under the default batching config?
- For SOC2 artifacts, a redacted copy is fine for now.

I'll try to review by early next week.

— Maya
Maya Shah
Head of Product, Omnitek
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Shah <maya@omnitek.ai>
Cc: nikhil_sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Are we still prioritizing? — deck receipt + quick walkthrough request

Hi Maya — wanted to bump this in case it fell off the plate. Were you able to review the estimate I sent last week (Redwood-Eval-Estimate-Omnitek.pdf)?

If priorities shifted, totally understand — quick check: is this still something you want to prioritize in the next 3–4 weeks? If yes, I can walk through the pricing assumptions and the SOC2 artifacts in 15 minutes and make any adjustments before procurement reviews it.

Possible 15-minute slots I have this week:
- Wed 3/17 09:30–09:45 PT
- Thu 3/18 11:00–11:15 PT
- Fri 3/19 08:30–08:45 PT

You can also pick a time here: https://calendly.com/lauren-bishop/15min

Attached a one-pager that summarizes the estimate and the two deployment options we discussed (hosted vs. dedicated): Pricing_Summary_OnePager.pdf (attached).

If you'd prefer, I can loop in our solutions engineer for a deeper ops conversation — happy to keep this very short and focused on the items that matter to your procurement team.

Quick ask: If this is no longer a near-term priority, could you reply with a rough timeline (e.g., Q2/Q3/undecided)? That helps us plan support and reserved-capacity availability.

Thanks again — appreciate it.
Lauren
From: Maya Shah <maya@omnitek.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.procure@omnitek.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Are we still prioritizing? — deck receipt + quick walkthrough request

Hi Lauren — apologies for the delay, we've been tied up with a product sprint. Thanks for the follow-up and for the one-pager — took a quick look and it's helpful.

Procurement (cc'ed) will need the SOC2 redacted evidence and the proposed SLA language; Arjun, can you flag any must-have clauses?

We can do a brief walkthrough to confirm assumptions. I'm available Tue 3/23 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 3/24 14:00–14:30 PT — either works for me for a 15–20 minute session. If those don't fit your calendar, send a couple alternatives.

On pricing: could you call out the expected per-request cost (approx) assuming our stated throughput? Also include an example cost for a 30-day pilot at 10k requests/day so procurement can see line-item math.

Thanks, looking forward to the quick sync.

— Maya
Maya Shah
Head of Product, Omnitek
